s-1.ptxt: Install Exhaust Pipe Assembly Center (Engine Type 2AZ-FE (FF))

s2.ptxt: Compression Spring Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.

atten3.ptxt: If it is less than the minimum, replace the spring with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Gasket Installation

s3.ptxt: Insert a new gasket into the exhaust center pipe assembly as far as it will go by hand.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Do not damage the gasket by dropping it, etc.
Do not damage the gasket sliding surface.
Never push the gasket in by installing the exhaust pipe without first pressing it in sufficiently by hand.

s3.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the exhaust pipe assembly front.

s2.ptxt: Install the exhaust center pipe assembly with the 3 exhaust pipe supports.
Install the exhaust center pipe assembly to the exhaust pipe assembly front with the 2 bolts.
Install the exhaust center pipe assembly to the exhaust tail pipe assembly with the bolts and 2 compression springs.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that there is no significant difference in the clearance between the flanges of the exhaust center pipe assembly and exhaust tail pipe assembly at the front, rear, left and right.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.

s-1.ptxt: Connect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Connect parking brake cable assembly No.1 to parking brake pull rod sub-assembly No.1 as shown in the illustration.
Release the parking brake.
Remove the instrument panel airbag assembly LWR No.1 (see ).
Remove the lock nut and loosen wire adjusting nut No.1.
Turn wire adjusting nut No.1 to adjust the parking brake pedal travel to the standard value.
Using a wrench, hold wire adjusting nut No.1 and tighten the lock nut.
After operating the parking brake pedal 3 to 4 times, check that the pedal travel is within the standard range.
Check that the parking brake does not drag.
When the parking brake pedal is released, check that the clearance between the operating lever and the stopper of the rear disc brake cylinder is within the standard range.
Install the instrument panel airbag assembly LWR No.1 (see ).
